# REVOLVYN

> REVOLVYN is a next-gen digital marketing agency for creators and brands. High-converting Meta ads, influencer campaigns, SEO websites, content production, social media management, AI UGC and cinematic brand films. 110+ YouTubers, 320+ brands, 4,500+ ads and campaigns.

## Services (Kolkata, India — serving brands across India)

- Growth Consulting, Performance Marketing (Meta ads, retargeting, full-funnel testing), Website + SEO (custom sites, technical SEO, content strategy), Content Production (35-40+ videos/month), Social Media Management, Influencer & Creator Marketing (110+ YouTubers, 20 creator videos/month), AI Content & UGC, Full-Service Bundle.
- Proof: 320+ brands, 4,500+ ads and campaigns, D2C / tech / lifestyle focus.
